newsitem.title: UK: Granada to make formal Yorkshire offer - FT.
newsitem.headline: Granada to make formal Yorkshire offer - FT.

text.p: British independent television company Granada Group Plc plans to make its formal offer for Yorkshire-Tyne Tees Television Holdings Plc next week, the Financial Times said on Thursday.
The report said the company was aiming to publish the offer documents on Monday but a delay was possible.
Granada, seeking to buy the 73 percent of Yorkshire it does not already own, has offered 11.75 stg per share and is negotiating with Yorkshire's board for an agreed bid.
Some institutional shareholders at Yorkshire are resisting, British newspapers have reported.
